brief.text: Borr Drilling (BORR) recorded the largest cluster total at $26.7 million, anchored by director Tor Olav Troim’s $6.36 million individual purchase. Dick's Sporting Goods (DKS) drew an unusually high consensus, topping all cluster counts with seven distinct insiders buying $5.59 million in stock. Meanwhile, closed-end funds saw widespread activity across both tables, headlined by multimillion-dollar cluster buys in BPRE ($13.0 million) and PSUS ($9.9 million), along with separate 10% owner purchases by Saba Capital Management in GF ($264,263) and MXF ($520,331).
